uncited: *   **Input:** A bottleneck feature vector $b \in \mathbb{R}^{256}$ derived from position encoding and previous network layers.
The network is a 3-layer Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) with 256 hidden units per layer.
A skip connection feeds the original bottleneck vector directly into the second hidden layer.
*   **When to use:** Rendering scenes with significant specularities or complex view-dependent appearance where smaller models produce artifacts.
*   **When not to use:** When memory is constrained and view-dependent effects are minimal.
Part of the broader development of efficient neural radiance fields for real-time rendering.
